spanish: Y cuando embiste buey a varón o a mujer, y muere, apedreando será apedreado el buey, y no se comerá su carne, y dueño del buey limpio.

findings.issue: Article-less נָקִי is the predicate of בַּעַל, the owner; the definite ox would take an article on an attributive adjective. “dueño del buey limpio” assigns limpio to the ox.

notes: The goring, death, stoning, and uneaten-flesh clauses match the tokens.
